attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Marrow League’s remaining settlements are now encircled","reason":"Briefing says only that the League is besieged, not that all its settlements are encircled."},{"span":"with no reinforcements in sight","reason":"The briefing says nothing about reinforcements."},{"span":"they have not offered any public statement on their long-term plans","reason":"Adds an unsupported detail about the Starling Tribe's conduct."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"It opens with the copied heading \"News since your last bulletin:\", which breaks the no-headings rule, and it presents the already-reported razing of Fenwick as fresh news. It also embellishes the siege with encirclement and reinforcement details, and the flat, bland prose loses Odile's sardonic voice."}
